newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia considers ASEAN meeting on Cambodia.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia considers ASEAN meeting on Cambodia.

text.p: Indonesian Foreign Minister Ali Alatas said on Monday he was trying to contact Malaysian Foreign Minister Abdullah Ahmad Badawi on the possibility of a meeting of ASEAN ministers on the Cambodian situation.
"I am trying to contact the present chairman of ASEAN (Badawi) in order to consult with him on the possibility of ASEAN foreign ministers meeting on this issue," Alatas said.
Alatas told reporters at parliament Indonesia was following events in Cambodia with great concern.

Forces loyal to the two Cambodian prime ministers, Hun Sen and Prince Norodom Ranariddh, fought each other on the streets of Phnom Penh over the weekend and Hun Sen's forces appeared to be in control of the city on Monday.

Cambodia, Laos and Burma are due join the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) at an annual meeting of foreign ministers in Kuala Lumpur later this month. ASEAN currently comprises Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore, the Philippines and Brunei.
Malaysian Acting Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim said on Monday Cambodia would still be admitted to ASEAN as planned.
